about: Decision table of hooks/safety/block-dangerous-commands.js. Each case is one constructed input and the decision that the hook must return. `rule` is the name of the rule that must refuse. A case with `reason` holds a decision that a reader could expect to be the other one; the sentence says why it is as it is.

text
